about: Ladysmith is a town on Vancouver Island’s east coast in the Cowichan Valley, between Nanaimo and Duncan, facing the Salish Sea. A former coal port, it is known for Transfer Beach, a steep downtown above the harbour, and 49th-parallel heritage. About 9,000 people live in Ladysmith.
